verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents mail forwarding as a plan feature, package shipping to any address with bundling, the option to have mail shipped directly instead of scanned, and generic automation rules, so self-service forwarding plausibly exists. However, the docs never tie the automation rules to forwarding specifically, and the story's other specifics are not documented. Missing for 10: explicit rule-based or one-click forwarding, saved recipient addresses, carrier/shipping-method choice, cost shown before confirmation, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, I can forward mail with rules or one click — saved recipients, carrier choice, and cost shown before I confirm — rather than emailing support
